content: Aime gageicne Wapongte yowa madicne nga dondonne fagac, yogo balaibelu weduyeledamec.

I yangucte, mamac yenge mogungne galu damongnagulu aibabanginengti alang-baba ailu gadabiyeng. Ailu yenge ngage-ngagesingngineng damongkelu ngic-ngigac yengele kwelenginengti angac ngageyelelu tatakic mikac sanangne gadabiyeng.

Aime nenggac yenge inguchac ngic-ngigac Wapongte ngage-ngage balaibecaigaing, yengele silic ingucne aibabanginengte alingka gadabiyeng. Ailu yenge ngic-ngigac gocne kwesac-yowa mi edocebadabiyeng. Ailu waing misa bocyac nolu, yogolec umacka mi gadabiyeng. Wiyac madicne fagac, yenge yogo ngic-ngigac weduyeledabiyeng. Aibaba ingucne yogo weduyeledamec.
Ilec nenggac yengi ngigac-adu ngawefocnginengkolec yenge yanguc weduyeledabiyeng. Yenge ngawefocngineng nga adu-madecfocngineng yenge kwelenginengti angac ngageyelelu
damongnagulu gbagbacne gadabiyeng. Ailu yenge mac-bolengineng balu madicne galu ngawefocngineng yengele yowa ngagedabiyeng. Inguc aibong monicti Wapongte yowa nalic mi milu suledaicte.
Ga soc-gboli ngic inguchac damongnaguningte ngage-ngagengineng kwefangkelu edocebadamec.
Ailu wiyac sasawa yogowa, gageuc galu aibabagone silicine madicne aiyengka balaibecgudabiyeng. Ga wewedu-yowagone yogo alang-babaineholec ailu yowa noineholec weduyelenong.
Aime ngabafocgone yenge gale yowa sowacne monic nalic mi miningte ailu gameebanale, ngic-ngigac yowa noine babaficineholec edocebalu gadamec. Nongele yowa kwekwe ingucne nalic mi aidaingte.

Kwelec kwekwe ngic-ngigac sugucnefocngineng yengeholec gagaing, yenge sugucnefocngineng yengele yowa sasawa balaibedabiyeng. I yangucte, sugucnefocngineng yengi ngageyelebong madickenale bolengineng balu sugucnefocngineng yengele yowa ameine mi bafaliyedaing.

Yenge sugucnefocngineng yengelacni wiyac monic hise mi badaing, miyac. Yenge bole sasawa bagacgu yowa balaibe-balaibele ngic-ngigac madicne aidaing. Ga inguc weduyeledamec. Ailu yenge aibaba ingucne aibong, Wapongti bikicte ameine Asa bacnubawec, yele wewedu-yowa yogo ngic-ngigac yenge yowa madicneineholec ngagedaingte.
I yangucte, Wapongte kwele-madicti ngic-ngigac sasawa yengela fikelu yegengkeme bikickacni wasecne ainingte kwele-madic bafuwayelewec.

Yesu Kristo, ye Wapong feicnetowa nga Asa-baba ngicnonggeng, yedi tapili nga hibi-angocka kwesilu fikelu yegengkedaicte. Ilec ailu wangec galu kwele-angacka gagabeleng. Inguc gaebengka Wapongte kwele-madicti yefe wedunoleme yanguctihac himongtowa yagolec aibaba nga angac lobe holecnodabeleng. Inguc ailu gaganonggeng damongnagulu yefe dondonne balaibelu Wapong alang bacnolu gadabeleng.

Aime Yesu Kristodi yefe-yowa wewele muckacni lukecnubanale, yeuctihac ngabafocine yengele molewa lonaguwec. Ailu suwecnubame nongileng yeicne ngic-ngigac ailu bole madicne mamang hidulu banangte aibaba yogo ainolewec.
Ga yowane yogo balu kwelengineng kwefangkelu ngelengkelu edocebadamec. Ga yowa sasawa yogo tapili geleicne, yogolec silicina edocebadamec. Aime monicti gale ngageme wawaine mi aidaic.
